Claim: 6672353180 (amended 6672467575) · Branch: `claude/project-thread-mwjmre` · Ruling-ref: 6670643454 (letter A, items 1–3) · ADR line: #30729 (merged) · Error code: #30724 / PR #30775 (merged) · Carry note: 6675092387 · Contract review: 6677642547 (FAIL, addressed at `d315efca97`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置里停用一个模块时，如果停用后对象上仍然生效的某条校验规则读了这个模块加到别的对象上的字段，停用会被拒绝（409，错误码 `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE`），提示里逐条列出「包 · 对象 · 规则」，什么都不改。规则按停用后对象实际生效的样子判断：同名规则只判胜出的那一份，客户在自己那份对象上关掉的规则算关闭，规则归到它生效文本所在的那一层（客户覆写层写作 `tenant overlay`）。用 `enableOnInstall: false` 覆盖安装时同样判断：装上，但保持启用，答同一个 409。公式读这些字段不拦（停用后答空值）。
- 为什么改：以前能停用，但停用后那条规则读不到字段，该对象的每一次写入都被拒（400 VALIDATION_FAILED），直到重新启用。这是 #30379 裁决 A（你 2026-11-05 21:56Z 的「同意」）；本版按合同复审 6677642547 改过。
- 风险与回滚：小。只多了一种拒绝，只在会把对象写死的停用上出现；读写接口、元数据和导出都不变。回滚即撤 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `readDisableDependentRules`（第二遍改为读注册表自己的折叠结果）、`ruleLayerLabel`、停用门和安装门的 409 分支；测试文件最后三个 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts`，预期 19 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/runtime`: `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id/disable`** (`domains/packages.ts`)

- After the read-only check (`isDisableablePackage` / `requireWritablePackage`), and before `registry.disablePackage` and `setPackageDisabled`, the door asks `readDisableDependentRules(registry, id)`. If that is non-empty, it answers `409` with `error.code` `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` (ledgered under `@objectstack/runtime` by PR #30775). The message names every rule as `package · object · rule (reads FIELD)`, one or several. Nothing changes on a refusal. The refusal carries no `error.details` beyond the code (the seat's ruling on carry-note item 2, see Out of scope).
- **What the disable withholds**, per object the package extends: the fields its `extend` contributions add that neither the owner's own declaration nor an extension that stays served also declares. This is the registry's own reading of a withheld member (`withholdDisabledExtensions`), asked of the state the disable would leave.
- **Which rules count** (ruling items 1–2, contract review must-fix 1): the rules the served object will carry once the disable lands, of every severity, from any enabled package, declared dependent or not (no `manifest.dependencies` entry is read), an app's `BASE.custom` pair included. They are read off the registry's own fold, `getAllObjects(undefined, { withoutExtensionsOf: id })`, never re-assembled in the door. So:
  - **one rule per name**, the copy the fold serves: a later layer's rule replaces an earlier one of its name (`mergeValidationsByName`), and only the winning copy is judged;
  - **the tenant overlay's switch is honoured**: its `message` and `active` sit on the packaged rule it names (`tenantRuleSettingsOf` / `withPackagedOwnerRules`), so a rule the tenant switched off through the overlay is off;
  - **less the rules the disable takes off a base that carries them** (`withoutWithheldMembers`), the one step a left-out fold does not take, which the scan mirrors.

  On an object whose owner is disabled or is the package itself, no write reaches any rule, so none counts. A package already disabled withholds nothing more, so the scan answers empty.
- **Who a rule is named after** (must-fix 1): the LAST layer in fold order (the base, then each `extend` contribution that stays) that declares the rule's name, which is the layer its served text comes from. A tenant overlay is named `tenant overlay of PKG` (or `tenant overlay` when it carries no package); the `(no package)` placeholder is gone (an unpackaged layer is `unpackaged object` / `unpackaged extension`).
- **What "reads" means:**
  - A predicate is read with `analyzeRelationshipTraversals` (`@objectstack/formula`) over `record` and `previous`. That covers `script` / `cross_field` `condition` and a `conditional`'s `when`, at any depth. It is the reading the rule validator itself asks before it refuses a write (`readsRecordColumn`).
  - A `record.REF.FIELD` read is also a hop into REF's target, judged with `referenceTargetOf` on the served field.
  - A `state_machine` / `format` / `json_schema` rule reads the `field` it names.
  - No second parser.
- **Not counted:**
  - a formula field over the withheld field (it answers `null`, PR #30362, ruling item 1);
  - a rule switched off (`active: false`, on its own copy or through the tenant overlay; the remedy the refusal names);
  - a rule a later layer replaced by name (only the winning copy is judged);
  - a rule of a disabled package.
- The code is held as its wire pair `{ code, status: 409 }`, the shape `check:error-status-conformance` reads as a producer.

**`@objectstack/runtime`: `POST /api/v1/packages` with `enableOnInstall: false`** (contract review should-fix)

- The install door's `enableOnInstall: false` arm asks the same `readDisableDependentRules(registry, pkgId)` before it disables. When a rule would read a field the disable withholds (an overwrite of an enabled package that asks to come back disabled), the install still lands, the package stays enabled on the row, in the registry and in the state file (all three follow the row the door returns), and the door answers the same `409` and code, with the message lead `Package 'ID' was installed and stays enabled: enableOnInstall: false cannot disable it`, instead of a `201` that claims a disable.
- With no reading rule, the arm disables as before (`201`, disabled).

**Docs** (carry-note item 3, must-fix 2)
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`: the advertised count moves from 57 to **58 error codes reachable on the wire** (L7; `packages/spec/src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts` pins it against the wire face). A `### PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` entry under *Conflict Errors (409)*, with cause (the served-fold judgment, the layer naming and the install arm), fix and `no_retry`. The status-conformance gate reconciles it against the producer above (`packages.ts: { code, status }`, 409).
- `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`: the Enable-and-disable step and the Disabling-a-module list gain the 409 row, a customer's switched-off copy counting as off, and the install arm. Before, they named only `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`.
- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`: the `PATCH /packages/:id/disable` entry names the refusal, the served-fold judgment, its remedy and the install arm.

**Changeset**: `@objectstack/runtime` patch, with the BREAKING banner (accept-set narrowing on both doors), `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts` is the PR #30362 harness: real `HttpDispatcher` doors over a file-backed SQLite kernel. It has 19 cases.

- `[#30379] the disable door refuses …` (3 cases). The fixture has:
  - a rules module with an error `script`, a warning `conditional`, a switched-off rule, and an info rule on the app's visit that reads `record.account.qx_credit`;
  - a formula module;
  - a tenant rule saved and published into the app's `.custom` pair, through `POST /packages/:app/ensure-customization` and the protocol's save and publish.

  The cases:
  - **Disable:** `409` with `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE`. The message reads `4 active validation rules read fields …` and lists exactly the four reading rules, in order (pair, two on the account, the hop on the visit), each with what it reads. The switched-off rule and the formula module are not named, and `error.details` is absent. The row stays enabled, the fields stay served, a write still lands and the state file does not list the package.
  - **Reading module disabled first:** the refusal names only the pair's rule (`an active validation rule reads a field …`). Once the pair is disabled, the disable proceeds (200), the fields are withheld, the formula answers `null` and writes land.
  - **Measured, not ruled:** re-enabling the reading module while the field stays withheld refuses writes with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the rule. That is the enable door, #30756; it flips this pin.
- `[#30379 contract review] the scan judges the rules the served fold serves` (2 cases). A third module extends the account at a later priority and redeclares two of the rules module's rules by name: one so it no longer reads the field, one so it does.
  - **Replaced by name (pin b):** `409` naming exactly 2 rules: the visit's hop, and the redeclared reader named after the override module. The rule whose winning copy no longer reads the field is not named, though the rules module's own copy still reads it.
  - **Tenant overlay (pin a):** a tenant overlay of the account (registered as `overlay`) switches the override's reader off and declares its own reader. The refusal names the visit's hop and the overlay's own rule as `tenant overlay of com.qa.extsuite`, and no `(no package)`. Once overlays switch every served reader off (`active: false`), the disable answers `200`, the module's fields are withheld (the overlay's copies of them included) and a write lands.
- `[#30379 contract review] POST /packages with enableOnInstall: false asks the same scan` (2 cases, a real `SchemaRegistry` and `HttpDispatcher` over a stub kernel):
  - an overwrite with `enableOnInstall: false` of an extender whose field another package's rule reads answers `409` with the code and the exact message; the package stays enabled, the state file does not list it and the field is still served;
  - **control:** with no rule reading the field, the same overwrite answers `201` and the package is disabled.
- The formula describe stays the CONTROL: a formula alone over the field ⇒ the disable proceeds (200) and writes land.

## Acceptance notes

- **The enable door is not judged here.** With the field's package already disabled, enabling a package whose rule reads the field is accepted, and every write to the object then answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the rule. A boot replaying such a state file ends in the same state. Pinned as measured. The mirror is #30756 (pm:blocked behind this card).
- **`disableable` is unchanged.** The package row's `disableable` (the door's PACKAGE verdict, ADR-0070 / #28318) still answers `true` for such a module. The dependent rule is an environment-state conflict, answered by the `409`. Showing it on the Settings page is the `domain:ui` card the seat files after this lands.
- **The install arm keeps the install.** A refused `enableOnInstall: false` does not roll the install back: the artifact the request carried is installed and enabled, and the `409` says so. Undoing the install would be a second write the request did not ask for.
- **`cross_field.fields` is advisory** (per the spec, only its first entry labels the violation), so a `cross_field` rule is judged by its `condition`.
- **A source that does not parse reads nothing here.** Such a rule already refuses every write, whatever is enabled.
- **The cloud route is not measured.** `/api/v1/cloud/environments/:env/packages/:pkg/disable` (`carrier: cloud`) was not run here.

## Out of scope

- **A machine-readable `error.details` shape** for the package · object · rule triples. The seat ruled (A) on carry-note item 2: no structured details, and no `packages/spec`. If the Settings page ever needs the triples machine-readable, that is a `domain:spec` contract card first: a `contracts/` schema plus the ledger row comment, the `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` pattern. The runtime would stamp it after that card lands. The seat records this on the UI card.
- **The enable door's mirror**: #30756.
